literal: Duty, they say, good things all, duty having known, perfection to those who undertake.
translation: The wise say that all good deeds are a natural duty for those who know their obligations and commit themselves to noble excellence.
modern: தம் கடமையை அறிந்து சான்றாண்மையை மேற்கொண்டு வாழ்பவர்களுக்கு, நல்ல செயல்கள் அனைத்தும் தாமே செய்ய வேண்டிய கடமை என்று அறிஞர்கள் கூறுவர்.
explanation: This couplet defines the mindset of those who strive for noble excellence. When a person understands their true responsibilities and commits to a noble life, they do not see good deeds as optional or extraordinary. Instead, they consider every good action as their basic, natural duty. The repetition of the word 'duty' emphasizes that excellence is a constant obligation to do what is right.
